patterns.note: Sections are clearly delineated by full-width background colors, creating distinct visual blocks that alternate between vibrant brand colors, light neutrals, and white.
A single vibrant purple-blue (#4A33FF) is used as the primary brand color, dominating hero sections and calls to action, providing a strong, consistent brand identity.
Headings use a bold, sans-serif typeface at significantly larger sizes than body text, establishing a clear and impactful typographic hierarchy.
Custom, friendly illustrations are consistently used across various sections to visually represent services and benefits, adding an approachable and modern feel.
The primary navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down, providing persistent access to site navigation.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header that remains visible at the top of the screen during scroll, ensuring navigation is always accessible. Content sections scroll beneath this fixed header.

Visual separation between content blocks is achieved by assigning distinct, full-width background colors to each major section, creating clear boundaries and visual interest without complex animations.
Custom illustrations are integrated into content sections, often paired with concise text, to visually explain complex services and benefits in an engaging and user-friendly manner.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) create strong visual anchors, complemented by legible regular-weight body text and smaller mono-spaced labels.
design_tokens.radius: subtle rounded corners on buttons and image containers, maintaining a soft yet modern aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced overall, with airy padding in the hero section and between major content blocks, contributing to a clean and uncluttered feel.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a single, vibrant brand color for large background sections and calls to action, combined with friendly, custom illustrations, creates an approachable yet professional feel that stands out for an insurance company. It avoids generic stock imagery in favor of a unique visual language.
